how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored before the next row (X14/X15's convention: `before` is the shipped source the row was run against and `after` the text that replaced it, so every `before` is findable verbatim in `file`). Device rows ran on lease E1-uivzs, pair-a (emulator-5574 + iOS 27 `nitro-ui A`, Metro 8295), on 2026-11-05; every filtered run is recorded under its own name and satisfies nothing else. The two rows added in fix round 1 follow the same convention against the fix round's own tree, and ran on lease `E1-7ojmj` (the same pair-a devices) on 2026-11-06. The rows added in fix round 2 ran on lease `E1-fei60` (the same pair-a devices) on 2026-11-06, and the connected-corner row was re-run there because round 1 wrote its `after` against a local `resting` val that round 2's file no longer has — see its note. The last row is not a mutation: it is the same check run against the row E1 replaced, recorded because it is the measurement behind the `segmented-control.md` claim that the semantics did not move. The merge round added two rows on lease `E1-jnmeq`, pair-a, on 2026-11-06: the first is the guard that keeps the Menu fallback re-measured here honest, the second is not a guard proof at all but the harvest that read the merged tree’s numbers, and its `mutation` says so.
